description: Read DOCX headers and footers per section, in document order. For each section_index (as in get_sections) it returns the default, first and even header and footer: relationship_id, part_name (e.g. word/footer1.xml), inherited (true when the section has no reference of that type and takes the previous section's, ECMA-376 Part 1 § 17.10.5), source_section_index, displayed (first needs title_page on the section, even needs even_and_odd_headers in settings) and paragraphs as {id, text}. Paragraph ids are the same session-relative `_bk_*` anchors as read_file, so replace_text and insert_paragraph edit header/footer text with them. A part shared by several sections is one story. Read-only apart from assigning paragraph ids. DOCX only.
name: get_headers_footers
